install.packages("ISLR2")

```

```{r}
library(BART)
library(ISLR2)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(ipred)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/lillianbates/stat-5610-project/data/train.csv")
set.seed(1)

n = nrow(data)
train_idx = sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.75 * n)
dev_test_idx = setdiff(seq_len(n), train_idx)

X = data[, !(names(data) %in% c("Y"))] 
X = as.data.frame(lapply(X, function(col) as.numeric(as.character(col))))
Y <- data$Y
```

K-fold validation with Parameter Tuning: 
```{r}
folds <- createFolds(Y, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
f1_scores <- c()

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  ntree  = c(100, 150, 200),
  k      = c(2, 5),
  power  = c(1, 2),
  base   = c(0.95, 0.99)
)

results <- data.frame()

for (g in 1:nrow(param_grid)) {
  params <- param_grid[g, ]
  cat("\nTesting parameter set:", paste(names(params), "=", params, collapse=", "), "\n")

  f1_scores <- c()

  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    cat("Fold", i, "\n")
  
    train_idx <- folds[[i]]
    test_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(data)), train_idx)
  
    x_train <- X[train_idx, ]
    y_train <- Y[train_idx]
    x_test  <- X[test_idx, ]
    y_test  <- Y[test_idx]
  
    # Fit pbart
    bart_model <- pbart(
      x.train = x_train,
      y.train = y_train,
      x.test  = x_test,
      nskip   = 400,
      ndpost  = 200, 
      ntree = params$ntree , 
      k = params$k, 
      power = params$power,
      base = params$base
  )
  
  y_pred_proba <- bart_model$prob.test.mean
  
  # Binary prediction using 0.5 threshold
  y_pred <- ifelse(y_pred_proba > 0.5, 1, 0)
  
  y_true  <- factor(y_test,  levels = c(0,1))
  y_pred2 <- factor(y_pred,  levels = c(0,1))
  
  # Compute F1
  f1 <- F_meas(y_true, y_pred2)
  f1_scores <- c(f1_scores, f1)
  
  cat("F1 score for fold", i, ":", round(f1, 3), "\n\n")
}

mean_f1 <- mean(f1_scores)
results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      ntree = params$ntree,
      k     = params$k,
      power = params$power,
      base = params$base,
      meanF1 = mean_f1
    )
  )

  cat("\nMean F1 for this parameter set:", round(mean_f1, 3), "\n")
}

# Print all results
print(results)

# Identify best parameter set
best <- results[which.max(results$meanF1), ]
cat("\nBest parameter set:\n")
print(best)
```
```
Creating predictions for submissions:  
```{r}
 bart_model <- pbart(
   x.train = X,
   y.train = Y,
   ntree = 200,
   k = 5,
   power = 2,
   base = 0.95 ,
   nskip   = 1000,
   ndpost  = 1000
 )

#Load test set 
test_data <- read.csv("/Users/lillianbates/stat-5610-project/data/test.csv")
X_test <- test_data[, names(X)]  # select the same columns as train

#Predict probabilities on test set
y_test_proba <- predict(bart_model, newdata = X_test)$prob.test.mean

#Convert to class labels using 0.5 threshold
y_test_pred <- as.integer(y_test_proba > 0.5)
rm(probs)
gc()

#Prepare submission dataframe
submission <- data.frame(
  ID = test_data$ID,
  Y  = y_test_pred
)

#Write to CSV
write.csv(
  submission,
  "/Users/lillianbates/Desktop/solution_1.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
